official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
EA LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
EA LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud

direct_official_checks: DTM removes surface objects to model terrain
DSM includes buildings vegetation vehicles and terrain
DTM production uses algorithms plus manual editing
point cloud contains x y z points and attributes
timestamped DSM and DTM are derived from point-cloud data
historic archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every surface model
DSM values cannot substitute for ground elevation
absence of matching point cloud must not invalidate an otherwise documented timestamped DTM
quality_effect: Prevents surface-object elevations and historic point-cloud gaps from corrupting ground-height interpretation.
